lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against the Ammonites, who exclaimed "Aha!" when Judah went into exile.
God will give Ammon to the people of the East and make Rabbah a pasture for horses.
Moab and Seir said Judah was like all the other nations, so God will expose Moab's frontier cities.
God will cut off man and beast from Edom, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, God will cut off the Amalekites and destroy the remnant along the coast.
